tools.name: resolve_did
tools.description: Resolve a DID (did:key, did:jwk, did:web, did:webvh) and report which evidence dimensions are established and which are not. Read-only; fetches the DID document from its origin.

tools.name: verify_credential
tools.description: Verify a W3C Verifiable Credential or SD-JWT VC (JSON object or compact string): signature, validity period and status list. Optional requiredClaims checks issuer-signed claim values. Read-only.

tools.name: inspect_mcp_server
tools.description: Inspect a remote MCP server over Streamable HTTP: protocol version, tool inventory fingerprints, declared annotations versus DID.is side-effect heuristics, and changes since the last observation. Read-only; never authenticates to the server.

tools.name: inspect_a2a_agent
tools.description: Fetch an A2A agent card (agent URL or card URL) and report its signature status, interfaces and skills. Read-only.

tools.name: authorize_tool_call
tools.description: Check whether a DID.is delegation chain (compact JWTs, root first) allows an agent to call a given tool. Returns ALLOW or DENY with the verified chain. Read-only; nothing is stored.

tools.name: evaluate_policy
tools.description: Evaluate a DID against declarative rules (allowed methods, curves, domain binding, TLS, linked accounts, verifiable history, credential status). Returns PASS, FAIL or INDETERMINATE (not a pass). Read-only.

tools.name: search_directory
tools.description: Search the public DID.is directory of DIDs whose controllers proved control and chose to be listed. Matches names and domains. Read-only.
